description: Done: PR ergoplatform/ergo#2456 approved by kushti and merged on 2026-08-10. Adds a logQueries directive in ErgoHttpService that logs method, relative URI, status and elapsed time at DEBUG, wrapping the route outside handleRejections so rejected requests are logged too, plus a commented-out logger in logback.xml and a spec asserting the emitted line via a logback ListAppender.
